mp.pillar: Sustained Dominance: higher positions, longer presence and higher peak positions on Most Popular.
observations: Most Popular refreshed after yesterday's repeated list. 113-day Steal An Egg still leads Brookhaven, Throw Food For Animals (58 days), 99 Nights in the Forest, RIVALS and 29-day DONT SPLASH.

The biggest risers were 18-day Voxel Wars (+35), Sell Fries! [Anomaly] (+27), Raise The Biggest Family (+24), 100 Days at Sea (+22) and Animal Hospital (Anomaly) (+21). Ragdoll Playground (-29), MM2 of The Monsters, Realistic Street Soccer, Farm Evolution and Tesla Roadster Chase fell 22-29.

Twelve games entered, among them Stop The Tsunami!, Sandworm Playground, Ragdoll Destruction Playground, the duo obby Gecko Duo, The Ditch Hotel, +1 Sukuna Evolution and the classroom game Class Clowns. Thirteen left, including Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, Ragdoll Sandbox, Realistic Ragdoll Engine and SF BIKE.

Recency of update fell back from 68% to 29% (H-mp-006), which confirms yesterday's jump came from the repeated list. Days since the last update still go with fewer days on the chart (rho=-0.32, best split at 32 days; H-mp-018, 65%).

By age, games over a year old have the highest median percentile (71) and 43-84-day games the lowest (29). Today the 85-122-day band (45) sits above that, so the mid-life trough (H-mp-009, 45%) does not show today.
patterns: Pricing is still the most durable page signal: games whose median pass costs over 149 R$ consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-001, 82%), and higher median product prices go with more days on the chart (rho=+0.25, best split at 374 R$).

Bigger servers consistently go with higher positions (H-mp-007, up from 55% to 71%), and social play tends to beat solo (H-mp-003, 68%). Profiled wave-survival co-op (median percentile 70) and roleplay hubs (68) sit high; party minigames (24) and idle tycoons (21) sit low.
A high favorite rate per visit consistently marks lower positions (H-mp-010, 89%; rho=-0.40). Big evergreens turn few visits into favorites, so this reflects audience breadth, not quality.
'Ragdoll' titles (8% of the chart) and 'Soccer' titles go with lower positions (r=-0.19 and -0.26). The ragdoll entries are mostly two-to-four-week-old sandboxes replacing one another.

outliers.name: 100 Days at Sea
outliers.note: A 366-day co-op survival game with no game passes rose 22 places, against the pattern that higher-priced pass ladders hold the chart; its sustained co-op survival loop seems to carry it.

outliers.name: Hyper Realistic Ragdoll
outliers.note: On all four charts yesterday at about 16 days, it left all four today. That is faster than any other wave decline seen so far, so a takedown or moderation event is as likely as a fading wave.

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Top Earning barely moved: the largest rise was +2 places, no game entered, and only Project Bikelife and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll left. Today adds little new evidence for this chart.
Efficiency leaders are unchanged: Clover RPG, Summer Donations, Trash Landfill Tycoon (68 days, no passes, eight products), Bloodlines, Enter Brainrot and Those Who Remain.
The least efficient remain young big-audience games with little to buy, plus Fling Things and People (not updated for 382 days).
Games under six weeks old have a median percentile of 25, against 62 for games over a year old (H-te-001, 84%).
patterns: Price level consistently leads: median product price (rho=+0.37, best split 79 R$; H-te-005 95%), median pass price (rho=+0.25, split 399 R$; H-te-025 95%) and a premium pass above 699-999 R$ (H-te-006, 95%).

RPGs (r=+0.55, H-te-011) and story-adventure loops (r=+0.40, H-te-046) consistently earn most per player, along with complex builds (rho=+0.26) and PvP combat (r=+0.26). Solo loops (r=-0.31), physics sandboxes (r=-0.53) and 'Ragdoll', 'Egg' and 'Steal' titles (r=-0.59, -0.57, -0.45) earn least.

Today's profiled Top Earning games lean on extreme premium ladders: Be a Pirate sells passes up to 29,999 R$, Dragon Soul up to 9,999 R$ and +1 Sukuna Evolution up to 4,999 R$. That fits H-te-006 but also shows the ceiling some young games test.

Vehicle games consistently earn well for their audience (H-te-049, 92%). Today's profiled examples: DigCrew, Trails, Young Street Ontario, Car Dealership Tycoon and SF BIKE all sell vehicles or vehicle tuning.

outliers.name: Trash Landfill Tycoon
outliers.note: Among the most efficient with no game passes and eight products, against the many-passes and premium-pass patterns; its haul-truck vehicle loop and cheap repeatable products may carry it.

outliers.name: Karinderya!
outliers.note: A 100-day co-op Filipino restaurant sim with 95.4M visits and no game passes sits at #479 while selling furniture products. That fits the pattern that cozy job sims draw players more than revenue.

tt.pillar: Early Momentum: rapid upward movement on Top Trending, among games 0–4 months old only.
tt.metric: daily position gain on Top Trending
observations: 14-day Volley Bomb (+26) leads momentum, ahead of Sandworm Playground (+23, 13 days), Stop The Tsunami!, Ragdoll Destruction Playground, The Ditch Hotel (+26) and the airline co-op Cabin Chaos.
+1 Boxing Battle Evolution rose 30, but +1 Sukuna Evolution fell 25 on the day it launched World 3. Be a Teacher! (-36), Shred The Cash (-23), A Bizarre Run (-23) and Build a Bridge (-21) also fell.

Nineteen games entered, including Ant Evolution, Class Clowns, untitled ragdoll game, Anime Ragdoll Engine, BloxNG and Run a Christmas Tree Lot. Twenty left, including Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, Fatal Baboons and Stack A Butter Squishy.
Games updated in the last day moved a median -7.5 against -2.0 for the rest, so same-day updates did not lift momentum today, even though recent updates tend to help across days (H-tt-005, 74%).
patterns: Genre is the clearest split: Survival games climb faster (r=+0.48, within-age +0.54; H-tt-077, 78% on position) and Simulation games climb more slowly (r=-0.41, within-age -0.45). A Simulation momentum test starts today.

Solo loops consistently climb more slowly (r=-0.45, within-age -0.48; H-tt-008 73%), and bigger servers go with faster climbing (rho=+0.28, best split above 6 players). A momentum test for servers above 6 players starts today.
Luck products and passes consistently go with slower climbing (r=-0.46 and -0.44; H-tt-076 74%, H-tt-039 74%), as do upgrade-shop loops (r=-0.37; H-tt-066 74%).
Original concepts consistently hold higher and climb faster (novelty rho=+0.31 on momentum; H-tt-069, 80%), while +1 and Evolution titles sit lower ('Evolution' r=-0.21).

outliers.name: +1 Boxing Battle Evolution
outliers.note: A +1 incremental that rose 30 on Top Trending and 55 on Up-and-Coming at 29 days, against H-tt-027 and H-tt-034. Its boxing-battle framing adds PvP, which may separate it from solo +1 clones.

outliers.name: Volley Bomb
outliers.note: Leads momentum with one game pass and eleven products. That goes against the larger-store patterns and fits the lean-launch-store patterns (H-tt-063).

uc.pillar: Breakout Popularity: higher positions within Up-and-Coming.
observations: Sandworm Playground (13 days) now leads, ahead of Ragdoll Soccer, Ant Evolution, Do Not Stop., Class Clowns and Stop The Tsunami!. Hyper Realistic Ragdoll and DONT SPLASH left the chart.

BoneBox Engine rose 79, +1 Boxing Battle Evolution 55, the classroom game Mukbang Students 47, Punch the Butter 36 and the horror game SAURUS 30. Ride a Bike Downhill! (-49), Be a Teacher! (-47), Rollercoaster Tycoon (-39), Shred The Cash (-36) and +1 Ghoul Evolution (-33) fell.

Seventeen games entered. Among today's profiled ones are four ragdoll fighters or sandboxes, two drawing games, Throw Key for Cars, Clean The Ballpit!, Superhero Universe and the fan-made boss rush CUPHEAD Fight!.
The eleven games 14 days or younger have a median percentile of 78, against 51 for 15-42-day games (H-uc-005, 62%).
patterns: Survival-genre games have the largest within-age effect today (r=+0.49, within-age +0.65), and horror escapes consistently rank higher (H-uc-057, 75%). A Survival-genre test starts today.

Store design: currency packs (r=-0.30), 2x passes (r=-0.25), luck passes (H-uc-018, 77%), auto-play passes (H-uc-030, 74%) and daily rewards (H-uc-062, 73%) go with lower positions; revives consistently go with higher ones (H-uc-021, 82%).

Originality (H-uc-039, 85%), complex builds (H-uc-067, 79%), frequent updates (H-uc-012 85%, H-uc-015 78%) and gameplay thumbnails (H-uc-040, 79%) consistently rank higher. Collection indexes now lean lower (r=-0.40).
Games that hand players weapons rank higher (r=+0.31, within-age +0.37), and emoji-heavy descriptions rank lower (rho=-0.20). Both start as tests today.

outliers.name: Survive Your Drawing
outliers.note: Entered at 8 days with a 34% like ratio and 102 developer products, against the like-ratio and lean-store patterns. The novel drawing-becomes-hazard hook seems to win clicks despite the ratings.

outliers.name: Ragdoll Soccer
outliers.note: Second on the chart with a 72% like ratio and a sports loop, against H-uc-041. The ragdoll wave seems to carry it more than the sport does.

summary: With Most Popular fresh again, the ragdoll wave is rotating rather than ending. Older clones (Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, Ragdoll Sandbox, Realistic Ragdoll Engine) left while 12-13-day ones entered (H-x-039 up to 38%), and the wave is branching into fighting variants such as Ragdoll MMA, Anime Ragdoll and Ragdoll Awakening (H-x-040 up to 30%).

The Survival genre is now the strongest breakout signal on both young-game charts (Top Trending momentum within-age +0.54; Up-and-Coming within-age +0.65), while Simulation and solo loops lag on both. Survival still earns poorly per player (H-te-021, 95%), so the breakout-versus-revenue split holds.

Luck, auto-play and currency products go with weaker breakout results on both Top Trending and Up-and-Coming, while price level, RPG and story loops lead Top Earning. That is consistent with launching lean and adding a store later (H-x-003, H-x-031).

Anomaly job sims (Sell Fries! +27, Animal Hospital +21; H-x-006 up to 62%) and classroom prank games (Class Clowns entered Most Popular; H-x-041 up to 32%) both gained. The teacher-side classroom game, Be a Teacher!, fell on both breakout charts.

Gameplay videos are still unlabelled for the fifteenth run: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are frames_ready with 0 frames and no contact sheets. No new outside research was waiting. 59 games were profiled today.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (266 entries, up from 256, median 2 days), followed by tt→mp (205, up from 198, 2 days) now that Most Popular refreshed.
uc→te (157, 5 days) and tt→te (145, 4 days) did not change, consistent with a quiet Top Earning day. te→tt stands at 99 (9 days) and tt→uc at 1.
Sandworm Playground went Up-and-Coming and Top Trending at 12 days to Most Popular at 13 days. Class Clowns entered Most Popular at 19 days, a day after joining Top Trending.
